outcome: Transfer to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Singleton term deliveries from 2000 to 2011 (665 breech deliveries with planned vaginal delivery, 43,595 vaginal deliveries in vertex presentation, and 876 planned cesareans in breech presentation)
finding: In our hospital, planned vaginal delivery is safe for breech presentations because it is associated with an increase of severe acidosis but not asphyxia.
mod_finding: Compared with 43,595 trials of vaginal delivery in vertex presentation at term, the 665 breech deliveries for which planned vaginal delivery was planned had a quadrupled risk of severe acidosis but no increase in the risk of asphyxia, NICU transfer or in-hospital death.
